rows.label: guest supported
rows.scope: A fixed-arity builder uses buildEither and buildOptional to select one marker and up to three children from event bytes. Native Swift and installed Guest UI V1 on arm64 macOS emit identical frames, preserve the previous frame on a four-child event, and continue on the next valid event. The guest registry reclaims the closed session slot.

The owned VM rejects the stale handle after close.
